summary: Gold's slide deepened into extreme fear as the dollar pushed above 102 and 10-year real yields held near 2.9%, dragging its RSI to 20 even as equities climbed. Stocks stayed in greed on a narrow, tech-led advance (QQQ +5.1%) while average-stock breadth slipped negative. Bonds extended losses, with TLT down over 5% in two weeks, and crypto volatility spiked near 21%.
tweet: Dollar strength and near-3% real yields hammered gold into extreme fear, a narrow tech rally kept stocks greedy, and duration pain kept bonds under pressure.
